cases.name: testSingleDeclarations
cases.src:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS very_long_method_name
    FOR TESTING.
    METHODS any_method_name
    FOR TESTING ##PRAGMA.
    METHODS very_very_long_method_name
    FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
cases.exp:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS very_long_method_name      FOR TESTING.
    METHODS any_method_name            FOR TESTING ##PRAGMA.
    METHODS very_very_long_method_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

cases.name: testAbstractMethods
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  METHODS test_setup ABSTRACT
    FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_functionality
   ABSTRACT
   FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_display
     ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.

  " comment on second group of test methods
  METHODS any_test_method_name ABSTRACT
    FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
  METHODS other_test_method_name
    FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

  METHODS test_invalid_input
     ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  METHODS test_setup             ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_functionality     ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_display           ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.

  " comment on second group of test methods
  METHODS any_test_method_name   ABSTRACT FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
  METHODS other_test_method_name          FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

  METHODS test_invalid_input     ABSTRACT FOR TESTING.
  ENDMETHOD.
